verdicts.reason: Both candidates are practically the same image. In each, the original's thin white frame ended up as a meaningless rectangle hanging over the racket. The two decorative rules have dropped out of place and now look like underlines under 'submitting' and 'Program'. 'by submitting to' is jammed onto one line with 'Xavier Sport Program', which breaks the original's stacked hierarchy. The blue panel runs off the bottom edge, has odd notched top corners and a big empty lower half, and the photo is blurry and over-cropped. The only difference is that the frame sits about 10 px lower in B, so neither is better.
